item.title: FDA grants accelerated approval to melanoma drug derived from herpes virus
item.description: Regulators approved a new treatment for advanced melanoma, offering doctors an additional option against the disease.

item.title: AAP updates flu vaccine guidance for all children aged 6 months and older
item.description: The American Academy of Pediatrics revised its recommendations for influenza vaccines and antiviral use in children.

item.title: Substance use disorders decline but treatment gap remains
item.description: Rates of substance use disorders fell among teens and young adults, yet many Americans with addiction still lack treatment.

item.title: First-night effect: why sleeping in a new place is often difficult
item.description: Many people struggle to sleep in unfamiliar surroundings due to the first-night effect, which disrupts rest.
